content:
FLYING SAUCERS” IN EAST GERMANY

#ufotwitter

Report by witnesses who saw unusual Disk-shaped  aerial objects in the sky over areas including an East German uranium mine.

Published (in press): July 9, 1952 (Athens press report translated into Greek)
Source: Greek newspaper I Kathimerini via CIA Foreign Documents collection
Location: Near Haselbach in the Soviet Zone of Germany (then East Germany)

Witness: Oscar Linke, 48-year-old former mayor of Gleimershausen who had recently escaped from East Germany into West Berlin with his family.

According to Linke’s sworn testimony before a judge:

He and his 11-year-old daughter, Gabriella, were returning home on a motorcycle when a tire blew out near the town of Hasselbach.

While walking toward the town, Gabriella pointed out a shape about 140 meters away. Linke initially thought it was a deer.

As he approached, he noticed two men wearing what appeared to be shiny metallic clothing standing over something on the ground.

Upon getting within about 10 meters, Linke saw a large object, estimating its diameter at 13–15 meters, which he described as looking like a huge frying pan or flying pan.

Description of the Object

According to Linke:

The object was a flat, disc-like shape with two concentric rows of holes around its edge (each hole about 30 cm in diameter, spaced roughly 0.45 m apart).

A black conical tower (about 3 m tall) protruded from the top of the object.

He saw no obvious means of propulsion or visible wings; the structure was unlike any known aircraft of that time.

The Men and the Takeoff

Linke reported the following sequence:

Two men (about 40 m away) were observing the object standing over it.

On hearing his daughter call, the men climbed onto the object’s conical top and disappeared inside.

The side of the craft then began to glitter, first green, then reddish, and emitted a slight hum.

The conical top retracted into the craft as brightness and hum intensified.

The object then rose slowly, rotated like a top, and was surrounded by a ring of flames.

A cylindrical column that had protruded to the ground disappeared into the craft as it lifted.

It ascended, shifted to a horizontal orientation, turned toward another town, and disappeared over the forests toward Stockheim, accompanied by a whistling sound similar to a falling bomb.

Linke’s Final Statements

After the object departed:

Linke returned to the site and found a circular opening in the ground, freshly dug and matching the shape of the craft’s conical tower.

He stated that, had it not been for the physical evidence, he would have assumed the experience was a dream.

Linke said he had never heard the term “flying saucer” before this event. He initially believed the craft might be new Soviet military technology, and expressed fear that the Soviets wouldn’t want such technology to be known. It's exactly the opposite they will do that as part of psychological warfare even if it's against their own people same applies to United States.

One constant in UFO sightings is a changeable glow, and for that reason, we think it's a comet. Have you recently seen so-called comets with a green glow and a fiery tail? The same descriptive characteristic has also appeared in some old UFO reports.
